name: Solenne Atelier Mirrorline Scarf
description: A long drape scarf in deep obsidian with a woven Mirrorline thread that creates a faint reflective sheen — shifting from matte to luminous as the wearer moves. The fabric is woven with passive signal-dampening threads that block ambient BCI broadcast bleed, offering a narrow privacy buffer in crowded boardrooms. Width is generous enough to function as a shoulder wrap, and one end is weighted with a single cast-iron bead in a brushed bronze casing.
functionality: Passive BCI broadcast dampening within 30cm, Mirrorline optical shift weave, weighted drape bead.
what_it_says: You have thought carefully about what you broadcast in a room full of people who are always listening.
story_hooks: The signal-dampening effect is narrow but real — someone has been using these scarves to conduct conversations in open boardrooms that don't appear in the building's ambient audio logs.
The weighted bead on a particular scarf has been hollowed out and used as a dead drop container; the scarf itself has changed hands four times in six months.
related_entities: Ringo Corponation SlipThread MX-3 Urban Cable Micro-Mobility Rig

physical_description.visual_profile: An elegant, elongated drape that reads as understated luxury. The scarf flows dramatically from shoulders, creating vertical lines that suggest movement even when still. The Mirrorline weave catches light subtly, creating an ethereal quality that shifts between shadow and gleam.
physical_description.fit: Generous, unstructured length—designed for multiple wrapping styles or as a single dramatic drape. Wide enough (approximately 18-20 inches) to function as a shoulder wrap or shawl. Weighted end grounds the fabric against the body.
physical_description.primary_material: High-grade synthetic blend with integrated signal-dampening fibers—likely a synth-silk composite with embedded conductive threads for privacy shielding.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost liquid to the touch with a subtle ribbed weave. Mirrorline threads create a faint raised texture that's barely perceptible. The fabric drapes with precision, not clingy.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep obsidian black as primary. Mirrorline threads create platinum and soft silver reflective accents that emerge under light, never garish—always refined.
physical_description.closures: None—pure drape design. The weighted bronze bead at one terminus provides balance and suggests intentionality.
distinctive_features: Woven Mirrorline thread with light-reactive reflective properties
Passive BCI signal-dampening weave for privacy in crowded spaces
Single cast-iron bead with brushed bronze casing at weighted terminus
Precise, architectural drape despite fabric weight
Barely-visible manufacturer signature woven into selvedge
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—boutique designer piece commanding 800-1200 Φ
physical_description.cultural_context: Corpo elite, particularly those navigating high-stakes boardroom politics where BCI eavesdropping is a genuine threat. Also favored by privacy-conscious creatives and medical professionals. Signals both wealth and operational security awareness.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when worn—this is a statement piece maintained meticulously. Subtle wear only after extended use, manifesting as minor pilling in high-friction areas.

Obsidian fabric catches cool overhead lighting, revealing shifting silver Mirrorline threads. The weighted bronze bead hangs prominently, catching warm accent light.
